hens_rule_text: Up to 4 fowl on lots of half an acre or less, up to 10 on lots over half an acre but under 1 acre, and fewer than 25 on 1 acre or more. The cap counts all fowl (chickens, ducks, geese, turkeys), not only hens.
permit_notes: The fowl section (Sec. 5.02) sets limits but does not require a permit or license to keep hens.
setback_notes: Fowl must be kept at least 50 feet from any habitation on another person's property.
coop_rules: Chickens must be kept inside a coop or pen. Ducks and geese may not run at large.
zoning_notes: Roosters are allowed only in areas zoned agricultural.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
code_section: Animals Chapter, Sec. 5.02 Keeping of Fowl

sources.name: City of Arlington Animals Chapter (Code of Ordinances), amended by Ord. 25-090

research_notes: Read the full text of Sec. 5.02 in the city-hosted Animals Chapter PDF, which is current through Ord. 25-090 (Dec 16, 2025). The code does not address slaughter, and no permit requirement appears in the fowl section.
